title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (393,838 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2022-2025 Tundra, Tundra Hybrid, and 2023-2025 Sequoia Hybrid vehicles. A software error may cause the rearview image not to display when the vehicle is placed in reverse. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Tesla, Inc.: Reverse Lights May Fail to Illuminate/FMVSS 108 (260 affected)
summary: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2026 Model Y vehicles. The reverse lights may fail to illuminate while the vehicle is in reverse, due to a defect in the wiring. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Driveshaft May Deform and Break (5,960 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2025 Tacoma and Tacoma Hybrid vehicles. The front driveshaft constant-velocity (CV) joint may deform and break.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Fire Risk from Quick Charging Battery (19,077 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2021-2022 LEAF vehicles equipped with a Level 3 quick charging port. The lithium-ion battery may overheat during Level 3 charging.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Fire Risk from Improper Starter Motor Wiring (135,386 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Santa Fe vehicles. The B+ positive terminal cover on the starter motor assembly may be improperly installed, which can cause an electrical short during a crash.

title: REV Recreation Group: Seat Fasteners May Damage Propane Hoses (39 affected)
summary: REV Recreation Group (REV) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Holiday Rambler Invicta, and Fleetwood Fortis recreational vehicles, equipped with the theater seat option. The theater seat fasteners may have damaged the Liquid Propane (LP) hoses, causing a propane leak.

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Auxiliary Engine Circuit May Overheat and Cause Fire (278 affected)
summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2022-2025 ST600 vehicles equipped with auxiliary engines. The auxiliary engine electrical circuit, including the starter and voltage regulator, may become overloaded.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Leaf Spring Bolt Failure (21 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Entourage recreational vehicles. A bolt may contact the truss support and fail, allowing the rebound clip to detach from the leaf spring.

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Battery Cables May Overheat and Cause Fire (30 affected)
summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2024 FOSV-CA vehicles. The interconnect battery cable routed between the chassis battery and the auxiliary batteries may overheat.

title: Autocar, LLC: Steering Wheel May Separate and Cause Steering Loss (4,687 affected)
summary: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2023-2026 ACX (Xpeditor) and DC (Legend) vehicles. The steering wheel nut may be improperly secured, allowing the steering wheel to separate from the steering column.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: Improperly Welded Seat Belt Anchor/FMVSS 210 (15,841 affected)
summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2020-2025 Mack MD, 2019-2025 Anthem, Granite, 2024 MD Electric, and 2025 Pinnacle trucks equipped with a passenger bench seat. The seat belt anchorage bracket may be improperly welded. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 210, "Seat Belt Assembly Anchorages."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Software May Cause Loss of Drive Power (790 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Ram ProMaster battery electric (BEV) vehicles. The electric drive module software may not effectively manage torque, which can result in a loss of drive power.

title: Lucid USA, Inc.: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (22,319 affected)
summary: Lucid USA, Inc. (Lucid) is recalling certain 2022-2025 Air vehicles operating a software version prior to 2.8.0. The lower console display may fail to show a rearview camera image or may show a delayed, inaccurate image of what is behind the vehicle. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Lucid USA, Inc.: Disconnected Half-Shaft May Cause Loss of Drive Power (225 affected)
summary: Lucid USA, Inc. (Lucid) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Air vehicles equipped with Pure Rear-Wheel Drive. Improperly secured bolts may allow the half-shaft to disconnect from the drive unit.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Improperly Welded Second-Row Seat Rails (54,631 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2025 Sienna Hybrid vehicles. The second-row seat rails may be welded improperly.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (1,324 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain Mopar Radios with part numbers 68639497AA, 68584184AA, and 68505724AA. The printed circuit board and software for the rearview camera may contain defects that cause the rearview camera image not to display properly.  As such, this equipment fails to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (62,910 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2020-2025 Alfa Romeo Giulia and Alfa Romeo Stelvio vehicles. The printed circuit board and software for the rearview camera may contain defects that cause the rearview camera image not to display properly.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Winnebago Towable: Improperly Installed Shelf May Fail (307 affected)
summary: Winnebago Towable (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2025 Access recreational trailers. The shelf above the bed may have been installed incorrectly, which can allow the shelf to detach.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Loss of Drive Power from Incorrectly Manufactured Driveshaft (3 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2026 R 1300 RT motorcycles. The cardan shaft may not have been sufficiently hardened, causing the universal joint to slip within the shaft and result in a loss of drive power.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Windshield Not Sealed Properly (3 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2026 X4 and X6 vehicles. The windshield may not be sealed properly, allowing water to enter the power distribution box or electronic control unit.

title: Continental Tire the Americas, LLC: Tire Tread May Detach (5,362 affected)
summary: Continental Tire the Americas, LLC (CTA) is recalling certain Continental TerrainContact H/T LT265/60R20 121/118R, CrossContact LX25 235/60R18 107V, CrossContact RX ContiSeal 275/40R21 107H, and General Grabber HTS 60LT245/75/R17 121/118S tires. The tires may have been produced using the wrong rubber compound, causing the tread to detach.

title: Genesis Supreme RV: Air Conditioner May Catch Fire (1 affected)
summary: Genesis Supreme RV (Genesis) is recalling one 2024 Supreme 28IKS fifth wheel trailer. The air conditioner soft start device may fail and overheat.

title: Autocar, LLC: Loss of Steering Control (2,848 affected)
summary: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2024-2026 ACX (Xpeditor) and DC (Legend) vehicles. The tie rod clamp may have been improperly secured.

title: Ford Motor Company: Passenger Air Bag May Deploy Improperly/FMVSS 208 (405 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Ranger vehicles. The instrument panel top cover may prevent the passenger air bag from deploying as intended. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: Braun Industries, Inc.: Cruise Control May Not Turn Off/FMVSS 105, 124 (413 affected)
summary: Braun Industries, Inc. (Braun Ambulances) is recalling certain 2023-2026 Chief XL Type I, Express Plus Type I, Liberty Type I, RMT US Type I, and Select Chief XL Type I ambulances. The brake pedal switch may have been damaged, preventing the cruise control from disengaging when the brake is depressed. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 105, "Hydraulic and Electric Brake Systems" and 124, "Accelerator Control Systems."

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Blown Fuel Pump Fuse (173,301 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2013-2021 NV200 Van, 2014-2017, 2019 NV200 Taxi, and 2015-2018 Chevrolet City Express vehicles. The Fuel Tank Temperature (FTT) sensor harness may have been incorrectly routed, damaging wires and causing a short circuit in the fuel pump fuse.

title: Jayco, Inc.: Murphy Bed May Fall Unexpectedly (53 affected)
summary: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2026 Heartland Bighorn and Jayco North Point fifth wheel travel trailers. The murphy bed mechanism may fail, causing the bed to fall unexpectedly.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Detached Shifter Cable May Cause Vehicle Rollaway (32,328 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain Mopar Gear Shift Control Cables with part numbers 68164081AB, 68085873AD, and 68085873AE. The shifter cable may detach from the transmission, preventing the vehicle from shifting into the park (P) position and causing a loss of park function.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Detached Shifter Cable May Cause Vehicle Rollaway (298,439 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US LLC) is recalling certain 2013-2016 Dodge Dart vehicles. The shifter cable may detach from the transmission, preventing the vehicle from shifting into the park (P) position and causing a loss of park function.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Insufficient Exterior Joint Strength/FMVSS 221 (2 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2026 Thomas Built SAF-T-LINER HDX2 school buses. Rear exterior joints may have been manufactured incorrectly, resulting in insufficient joint strength. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 221, "School Bus Body Joint Strength."

title: Ford Motor Company: Reduced Brake Function/FMVSS 135 (13,451 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020 Escape vehicles. The rear brake pads may have been manufactured incorrectly, which can reduce brake function in the event of a brake booster malfunction.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 135, "Light Vehicle Brake Systems."

title: Ford Motor Company: Unintended Acceleration May Occur due to Disabled Safety Features (1,048 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain Ford Mustang superchargers with part number M-6066-M8800, that were sold as aftermarket accessory kits for 2024-2025 Mustang vehicles. The powertrain control module (PCM) may experience a software error and disable functional safety features. Deactivated safety features can fail to prevent unintended acceleration or unintended vehicle movement.

title: Supreme Corporation: Battery Box May Detach (137 affected)
summary: Supreme Corporation (Supreme) is recalling certain 2025 Wabash insulated truck body vehicles. The assembly bolts used to attach the auxiliary battery box may be misaligned, allowing the bolts to break.

title: Ford Motor Company: Missing Pedestrian Warning Sound (43,438 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Lincoln Nautilus Hybrid and 2025 Explorer hybrid police vehicles. A software error may prevent the vehicle from emitting the pedestrian warning sound at certain speeds.

title: Tesla, Inc.: Battery Connection Failure May Cause Loss of Drive Power (12,963 affected)
summary: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2025 Model 3 and 2026 Model Y vehicles. The battery pack contactors may fail, causing a loss of drive power.

title: Ford Motor Company: Low Brake Fluid Warning Inoperative/FMVSS 135 (2,101 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Mustang vehicles repaired incorrectly under recall number 23V727. The brake fluid level sensor may not activate the visual warning indicator when the brake fluid is low.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 135, "Light Vehicle Brake Systems."

title: Forest River, Inc.: Missing Over Current Protection May Cause Fire (20,305 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Forest River Aurora, Coachmen Catalina, 2026 Coachmen Viking, Coachmen Clipper, 2016-2026 Wildwood, and Salem recreational trailers. The distribution panel wire may be connected to the battery without over current protection.

title: Ford Motor Company: Rear Combination Light Assembly May Fail/FMVSS 108 (84 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Lincoln Corsair vehicles. Water may leak into the left and right rear combination lights, possibly resulting in a loss of reverse light, tail light, brake light, or rear turn signal function. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Ford Motor Company: Trailer Hitch Assembly May Detach (1,412 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Explorer and 2024-2026 Lincoln Aviator vehicles. The trailer hitch assembly bolts may be loose.

title: Ford Motor Company: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display Properly (291,901 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2022 F-250 SD, F-350 SD, and F-450 SD vehicles. The 360-degree view camera system may not display a rearview image properly in certain lighting conditions.

title: Ford Motor Company: Engine Block Heater May Short Circuit and Cause Fire (2,571 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain engine block heaters, with part numbers GJ7Z-6A051-BA and GJ7Z-6A051-AA, sold as accessory parts. The engine block heater may crack and develop a coolant leak, causing it to short circuit when the block heater is plugged in.

title: Ford Motor Company: Engine Block Heater May Short Circuit and Cause Fire (59,006 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2016-2019 Lincoln MKC, 2016-2023 Explorer, 2019-2020 Fusion, 2019-2024 Ranger, 2020-2022 Lincoln Corsair, Escape, 2021-2024 Bronco, Bronco Sport, and 2022-2024 Maverick vehicles. The engine block heater may crack and develop a coolant leak, causing it to short circuit when the block heater is plugged in.

title: Ford Motor Company: Block Heater May Overheat and Cause Fire (2,204 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain engine block heaters, with part number number JL3T-6A051-AB. These parts were sold as accessories for certain 2023-2026 Ford vehicles equipped with a 1.5L or 2.0L Modular Power Cylinder (MPC) engine. The engine block heater may overheat when the vehicle is parked with the block heater plugged in.

title: Brenner Tank, LLC: Incorrect Emergency Valve May be Damaged and Leak (4 affected)
summary: Brenner Tank, LLC (Brenner Tank) is recalling certain 2026 TKQXFR tank trailers equipped with split rear impact guards. The incorrect emergency valve was installed. The valve may be damaged during a crash and leak.

title: Ford Motor Company: Inadequate Windshield Bonding/FMVSS 212 (9 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Bronco and Ranger vehicles. During manufacturing, the windshield may not have been properly bonded to the vehicle, allowing it to detach in a crash.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 212, "Windshield Mounting."

title: Forest River, Inc.: Sewer Gas May Enter Vehicle (8 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026 Flagstaff, and Rockwood recreational trailers. The waste water holding tank ventilation pipe may not be terminated outside the vehicle, which can lead to sewer gas entering the vehicle.

title: Ford Motor Company: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display (1,448,655 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2015-2019 Flex, 2015 Explorer, Lincoln MKT,  Lincoln MKZ, 2015-2016 C-Max, Escape, Taurus, 2016 Fusion, 2018-2019 Taurus, 2019 Lincoln MKT, Fiesta, and 2020 Mustang vehicles.  The rearview camera may display a distorted,  intermittent, or blank image when the vehicle is in reverse.

title: Toyo Tire Holdings of Americas, Inc.: Tire Tread May Separate (36,919 affected)
summary: Toyo Tire Holdings of Americas, Inc. (Toyo) is recalling certain Open Country A/T III, Open Country R/T Trail, Open Country M/T, Open Country H/T II, Crosstek 2, Dura Grappler Highway Terrain, Exo Grappler AWT, Mud Grappler Extreme Terrain, Recon Grappler A/T, Ridge Grappler, Terra Grappler G3 A/T, and Trail Grappler M/T tires. Please see the attached tire chart for all affected sizes. Contamination during production may reduce adhesion and cause the tread to separate.

title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: DOT Code Mark Missing from Driver's Door Window/FMVSS 205 (2 affected)
summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2019-2020 LFS commercial buses. The driver's door windows may have been built with the prime glazing manufacturer DOT code mark missing. As such, these vehicles fail to conform to Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 205, "Glazing Materials."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Loss of Drive Power (1,057 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain Mopar Fuel Delivery Modules with part numbers 68348890AA, 68356890AA, 68408467AA, 68408468AA, 68411153AA, and 68411154AA. The fuel pump may fail, which can result in a loss of fuel flow and loss of drive power.

title: International Motors, LLC: Transmission May Not Shift into Reverse (1,671 affected)
summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2026 IC Bus CESB school buses. The transmission shift actuator may not have been calibrated properly, preventing the transmission from shifting into reverse.

title: International Motors, LLC: Transmission May Not Shift into Reverse (97 affected)
summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2026 MV commercial trucks. The transmission shift actuator may not have been calibrated properly, preventing the transmission from shifting into reverse.

title: Winnebago Towable: Label Lists Incorrect Tire Size/FMVSS 110 (377 affected)
summary: Winnebago Towable (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2019 Micro Minnie5, Minnie Drop, 2020 Minnie Plus5, 2018-2021 Minnie, and 2022 Hike 100 travel trailers. The Federal tire label may list the incorrect tire size. As such these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) No. 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Coolant Leak Inside EGR Module May Cause Fire (112 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2018 328D SportsWagon, 328D xDrive SportsWagon, 328D xDrive, and 328D diesel vehicles equipped with an exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) module with an integrated cooler. The EGR cooler may leak internally, causing coolant to mix with diesel engine soot, which could result in smoldering particles and a melting intake manifold.

title: Tesla, Inc.: Front Parking Lights May Be Too Bright/FMVSS 108 (63,619 affected)
summary: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Cybertruck vehicles operating software prior to 2025.38.3. The vehicle controller software may cause the front parking lights to be too bright and exceed the maximum light output, adversely affecting the vision of other drivers. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Gear Shift Position Indicator Light May Fail to Illuminate/FMVSS 101 (293 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2025 Range Rover, Range Rover Sport, Discovery Sport, and 2026 Range Rover Evoque, and Jaguar F-Pace vehicles. Moisture may have entered the gear shift module (GSM) during assembly, which can cause the gear shift position indicator light to fail. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 101, "Controls and Displays."

title: General Motors, LLC: Tire Tread May Detach (22,914 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Cadillac Optic and 2025-2026 Chevrolet Equinox EV vehicles equipped with 21-inch Continental all-season tires. One or more of these tires may experience partial or full tread detachment.

title: Daimler Vans USA, LLC: Loss of Automatic Emergency Braking (16 affected)
summary: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2025 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter 2500 vehicles. The front short-range radar sensor printed circuit board may fail and result in a loss of automatic emergency braking and other driver assistance features.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Loss of Automatic Emergency Braking (12 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2025 AMG G63 and G 580 vehicles. The front short-range radar sensor printed circuit board may fail and result in a loss of automatic emergency braking and other driver assistance features, including the active brake assist, lane keeping assist, and Distronic cruise control.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Loss of Drive Power from Over-The-Air Software Update (24,238 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Jeep Wrangler 4XE Plug-In Hybrid Electric (PHEV) vehicles. A software error in an over-the-air (OTA) update may result in a loss of drive power.

title: Thor Motor Coach: Liquid Propane Hose May Contact Generator Exhaust (527 affected)
summary: Thor Motor Coach (TMC) is recalling certain 2026 Geneva, 2025-2026 Quantum, Four Winds, Pasadena, Eddie Bauer, Chateau, Freedom Elite, and Coleman recreational vehicles. A P-clamp may not have been installed, allowing the Liquid Propane (LP) generator hose to contact the exhaust.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Exterior Stowed Griddle Can Cause Fire (38 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026 Wildwood and Salem travel trailers. The exterior griddle may be stowed while still connected to LP gas line.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Incorrect Tire Inflation Information on Label (23 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 Stealth EVO, RPOD, 2025-2026 Wildwood, and Salem recreational trailers. The tire information label may list the incorrect tire inflation information.

title: Alexis Fire Equipment Company: Defective Latch May Prevent Door from Opening (22 affected)
summary: Alexis Fire Equipment Company (Alexis Fire) is recalling certain 2020-2025 Pumper, 2024 Rescue, and 2020-2024 Tanker fire trucks built on Spartan chassis. The actuator lever arm in the Spartan cab door latch may bind or become wedged, preventing the door from opening.

title: REV Recreation Group: Paddle Latch May Unintentionally Lock Liquid Propane Compartment (244 affected)
summary: REV Recreation Group (REV) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Holiday Rambler Invicta and Fleetwood Fortis recreational vehicles equipped with Lippert Paddle latches with part number 2021097882. The paddle latch may unintentionally lock, preventing operators from accessing the Liquid Propane (LP) compartment.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Damaged Seat Belt Retractor (1,024 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC is recalling certain 2026 2 Series Gran Coupe, X1, X2, and Mini Countryman S ALL4 vehicles. The housing pin in the rear (left and/or right) seat belt retractors may have been damaged during production, resulting in the retractor not locking the seat belt as intended.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply to Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 209, "Seat Belt Assemblies."

title: Ferrari North America, Inc.: Loose Oil Filter Connection May Leak (6 affected)
summary: Ferrari North America, Inc. (Ferrari) is recalling certain 2025 296 GTS and 296 GTB vehicles. The nut securing the oil filter connection to the turbocharger oil feed pipes was tightened incorrectly and may cause an oil leak.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Headlights Can Be Misadjusted/FMVSS 108 (2,195 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Fiat 500e Battery Electric (BEV) vehicles. The headlight horizontal aim adjustment is not covered as intended, which can result in improperly adjusted headlights. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Forest River, Inc.: Incorrect GVWR and CCC Information on Label/FMVSS 110 (100 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Alta travel trailers. The Federal Placard label may have the incorrect axle capacity listed, causing the Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) and Cargo Carrying Capacity (CCC) to have been miscalculated. As such these vehicles fail to comply with the Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) No. 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

title: Alloy Custom Products LLC: Improperly Welded Suspension Tower (180 affected)
summary: Alloy Custom Products LLC (Alloy) is recalling certain 2023-2025 cryogenic tank trailers. The suspension tower may have been improperly welded.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: Axle Stabilizer Bracket May Detach (17,084 affected)
summary: Isuzu Motors Limited (Isuzu) is recalling certain  2022-2026 Isuzu FVR, 2023-2026 Chevrolet 7500XD, 2018-2026 Chevrolet 6500XD, and Isuzu FTR vehicles. The axle stabilizer bracket bolts may crack and break, allowing the bracket to detach from the vehicle.

title: Wartech Engineering, LLC: Brakes May Not Operate as Intended (18 affected)
summary: Wartech Engineering, LLC (Wartech) is recalling certain 2022-2025 SpecialContainer trailers. The incorrect threaded piping fitting may have been installed between the anti-lock braking system (ABS) module and the air tank. The fitting may leak air, decreasing the pneumatic brake pressure.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Loose Gearshift Pedal/FMVSS 123 (340 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2025 CB1000SP Hornet SP motorcycles. The pivot bolt on the gearshift pedal may loosen and detach, resulting in the inability to shift gears. As such, these motorcycles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 123, "Motorcycle Controls and Displays."

title: Maserati North America, Inc.: Missing Headlight Aim Adjustment Caps/FMVSS 108 (10,008 affected)
summary: Maserati North America, Inc. (Maserati) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Grancabrio, 2024-2025 Granturismo, and 2023-2025 Grecale vehicles.  The headlights may be missing adjustment prevention caps, which can allow the headlights to be improperly adjusted. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamp, Reflective Devices and Associated Equipment."

title: Ford Motor Company: Loose Bolt in Driver's Seat Frame (163,256 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Bronco vehicles. The front seats may have a loose or dislodged seat frame height-adjust pivot bolt.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Radiator Fan Electrical Circuit May Overheat (300,691 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2018-2026 Ram ProMaster vehicles. The electrical circuit for the radiator fan may overheat.

title: Carry-On Trailer Corp.: Incorrect GAWR on Certification Label (7,088 affected)
summary: Carry-On Trailer Corp. (Carry-On Trailer) is recalling certain 2024-2026 6X8GW2KPT trailers. The Gross Axle Weight Rating (GAWR) listed on the certification label is incorrect. As such, these trailers fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 567, "Certification."

title: Ford Motor Company: Automatic Transmission May Not Shift Into Park (34,481 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 10R80 re-manufactured automatic transmissions, that were used as service repair parts for 2017-2021 Ford and Lincoln vehicles. Please see the recall report for the complete list of part numbers. The automatic transmission T10 bearing may not have been installed, which can prevent the transmission from holding the Park position.

title: Ford Motor Company: Driver and Passenger Door Trim May Detach (92,347 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2017-2019 Flex vehicles. The driver and front passenger B-Pillar door trim may detach while driving.

title: Ford Motor Company: Rear Lightbar May be Inoperative (14,843 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022-2023 F-150 Lightning BEV vehicles previously repaired under recall number 23V418. The rear lightbar may have microcracks in the outer lens that allows moisture to accumulate, which can result in inoperative or flickering reverse lights.

title: Ford Motor Company: Windshield Air Bubbles Can Obscure Visibility/FMVSS 205 (56,841 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Lincoln Corsair, Lincoln Aviator, and Explorer vehicles. The windshield glass may have visible air bubbles, which can obscure the driver's visibility. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 205, "Glazing Materials."

title: Ford Motor Company: Moonroof Wind Deflector May Detach (174,853 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Expedition, Lincoln Navigator, 2021-2023 F-150, 2022 F-250 SD, F-350 SD, and F-450 SD vehicles. The moonroof wind deflector clips may be inadequately attached to the moonroof frame, which can result in the wind deflector detaching from the vehicle.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Contact with Chassis May Damage Tire (8 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026 Coachmen Catalina travel trailers. The chassis outrigger may contact and puncture the tire.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Fresh Water Tank May Detach (1,868 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2021 XLR Toy Hauler travel trailers. The mounting brackets may be improperly located or secured, allowing the fresh water tank to detach when full.

title: Ford Motor Company: Inoperative Defrosting and Defogging System (6,909 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2026 Econoline vehicles. The heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC) system blower motor may fail, which can cause the defrosting and defogging system to become inoperative.

title: Daimler Vans USA, LLC: Improperly Reinforced Frame Member (366 affected)
summary: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter 2500 vehicles. The right longitudinal frame member may not be reinforced properly, decreasing the structural integrity of the third-row seats.

title: Jayco, Inc.: Axle Information Reversed on Certification Label (100 affected)
summary: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Entegra Condor and Jayco Granite Ridge motorhomes. The Certification Label may have the front and rear axle information reversed. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."

title: Tesla, Inc.: Off-Road Light Bar May Detach and Become a Road Hazard (6,197 affected)
summary: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2024 Cybertruck vehicles equipped with a service-installed off-road light bar accessory. An incorrect surface primer may have been used to attach the lightbar to the windshield, causing the light bar to loosen and detach.

title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: Improperly Installed Wheelchair Seat Belt Anchor/FMVSS 210 (31 affected)
summary: Prevost Car (US) Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain 2025 X3-45 Commuter buses. The wheelchair seat belt anchorage may have been improperly installed. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 210, "Seat Belt Assembly Anchorages."

title: Mazda North American Operations: Front Suspension Bolts Not Tightened Properly (1,007 affected)
summary: Mazda North American Operations is recalling certain 2025 CX-50 and CX-50 Hybrid vehicles. The front suspension fastener bolts may not be tightened properly, which can result in suspension component and/or wheel detachment.

title: Remote Vans: Optional Equipment and Max Occupancy May Overload Motorhome/FMVSS 110 (46 affected)
summary: Remote Vans is recalling certain 2025 Aegis and Oasis motorhomes. Optional equipment may cause the motorhome to exceed Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) when carrying the maximum number of occupants. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 110, “Tire Selection and Rims” and 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."

title: Autocar, LLC: Automatic Emergency Braking System May Unexpectedly Turn Off (239 affected)
summary: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2025-2026 ACX (Xpeditor) vehicles. The Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB) system may unexpectedly turn off when the vehicle turns.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (1,024,407 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2022-2026 Toyota, Lexus, and Subaru Solterra vehicles equipped with a Panoramic View Monitor (PVM) system. Please see the recall report for a complete list of models. A software error may cause the rearview camera to freeze or display a blank screen when the vehicle is in reverse. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Jayco, Inc.: Slide-Out Room May Extend While Driving (144 affected)
summary: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2026 Entegra Cornerstone Reserve, 2025-2026 Cornerstone, Aspire, and Anthem recreational vehicles. The slide-out room can be deployed without the parking brake engaged, allowing the room to extend while the vehicle is in motion.

title: Smeal Holding, LLC: Improperly Manufactured Aerial and Outrigger Hydraulic Hoses (29 affected)
summary: Smeal Holding, LLC (Smeal) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Rear Mount Platform, Mid Mount Platform Aerial, and 2024, 2026 125' Aerial emergency response vehicles. A defective crimp may cause the high-pressure hydraulic hose to separate and leak hydraulic fluid.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): High Voltage Battery May Fail and Cause Fire (320,068 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2020-2025 Jeep Wrangler 4Xe and 2022-2026 Grand Cherokee 4Xe vehicles. The high voltage battery may fail internally and lead to a vehicle fire while parked or driving.

title: KTM North America, Inc.: Fuel Filler Cap Seal May Leak Fuel (5,488 affected)
summary: KTM North America, Inc. is recalling certain 2024 390 Duke, 250 Duke, 990 Duke, Husqvarna Vitpilen 401, and Husqvarna Svartpilen 401 motorcycles. The seal on the fuel filler cap may develop cracks and leak fuel.

title: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc.: Wheelchair Restraint Retractor May Not Lock (64 affected)
summary: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc. (Micro Bird) is recalling certain 2024-2026 G5 and 2025 T-Series transit buses equipped with certain QRT-Deluxe and QRT-Max wheelchair restraints. The retractors may not lock, preventing the wheelchair from being properly secured.

title: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc.: Wheelchair Restraint Retractor May Not Lock (180 affected)
summary: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc. (Micro Bird) is recalling certain 2023-2026 G5 and 2025 T-Series school buses equipped with certain QRT-Deluxe and QRT-Max wheelchair restraints. The retractors may not lock, preventing the wheelchair from being properly secured.

title: Par Nado inc: Cooktop Gas Valves May Crack Causing Gas Leak (145 affected)
summary: Par Nado Inc (Par Nado) is recalling certain 2019-2020 Alto F2114 and F1743 travel trailers equipped with certain Dometic PI8022 2-burner LPG cooktops. The aluminum burner tubes that connect to the gas valves may crack and cause a gas leak.

title: The Heil Co.: CNG Manual Cylinder Valve May Crack And Leak (50 affected)
summary: The Heil Co. (Heil) is recalling certain 2023-2025 side loader garbage trucks equipped with certain Agility Fuel Solutions CNG Fuel Systems, using part number 10300466. The manual cylinder valves may develop stress corrosion cracks in the bottom plugged port, causing a leak.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Driver's Side Front Air Bag Inflator May Explode (5,361 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2000-2001 X5 vehicles that may be equipped with a sport steering wheel containing a Takata PSDI-4 air bag inflator.  The inflator may explode during deployment due to propellant degradation occurring after long-term exposure to high absolute humidity, temperature, and temperature cycling.

title: Braun Corporation: Wheelchair Restraint Retractor May Not Lock (2,810 affected)
summary: Braun Corporation (Braun) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Chrysler Pacifica, 2022-2025 Toyota Sienna, and 2022-2026 Honda Odyssey vehicles equipped with wheel chair restraint retractors. The retractors may not lock, preventing the wheelchair from being properly secured.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Wheel May Detach from Vehicle (406,290 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 18-inch aluminum alloy wheels sold as accessories for 2016-2021 Civic vehicles. A manufacturing error may allow the wheels to detach from the vehicle.

title: Kia America, Inc.: Incorrect Spare Tire/FMVSS 110 (45 affected)
summary: Kia Motors America (Kia) is recalling certain 2025 Telluride and 2026 Sorento vehicles. The vehicles are equipped with an incorrect spare tire which, when installed, can impair the anti-lock braking system (ABS) and the traction control system (TCS). As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."
